research_question: Can the frozen 458-case CONFLICTS expected-behavior package be assigned to three independent people in balanced, resumable, method-blind batches while detecting inadequate within-reviewer consistency before any inter-annotator or method comparison?

batching.primary_strata: gold conflict type crossed with official-answer availability
batching.primary_assignment: Within each stratum, stable-hash order followed by round-robin assignment; reviewer slots receive deterministic rotations.
batching.repeat_selection: Approximately proportional by conflict type with at least one repeat from every conflict type.
batching.repeat_placement: Each repeat is placed exactly half of the eight-batch cycle away from its primary occurrence.

public_batch_contains: blinded A/B responses and their shown sources
blinding.public_routing_commitment: Canonical JSON SHA-256 in the operations manifest.
blinding.reviewer_instruction: Complete every task independently and do not inspect other reviewers' forms, private routing, implementation code, or method mapping.

quality_control.cohen_kappa_role: Descriptive only; null with UNDEFINED_NO_VARIANCE when marginal variance is absent.
quality_control.failure_policy: Any dimension below the exact-agreement threshold makes the role ineligible for inter-annotator comparison until independently reviewed and recollected under a new registered operation.
quality_control.repeat_interpretation: Hidden repeats measure within-reviewer consistency and do not create gold labels or adjudicated results.

decision_boundary.interpretation: This protocol reduces operational and reproducibility risk only. It cannot substitute for three independent people, flood-domain expert validation, or deployment evidence.
